interpretation: The library keeps healthy clients at target throughput and near-perfect fairness when 10 percent of peers are impaired. Moderate loss remains serviceable. Poor links become variable and disconnect some peers. Severe links preserve healthy service but spend almost the entire affected offered rate on undelivered work while delivering almost nothing, with a maximum observed single-peer queue of about 22 MB; netem's implicit 1000-packet limit confounds that profile. In the one-way blackhole, all ten affected peers were no longer open by the second window and retries ceased, but counter resets hide exact event timing. This is good isolation with partial cleanup evidence, not yet precise proof of bounded disruption handling.
